title: Supplier Relationship and Performance Evaluation
purpose: Assess supplier performance, buying-organization performance and shared relationship outcomes fairly using one 100-point profile per engagement type.

source_reference.file_name: SRM template - MRO CAPEX And SERVICE.xlsx
retained_principles: Quality/technical, service, commercial and innovation performance areas
Ordinary SLA target rating 4; rating 5 for exceeding expectations
Separate organization and supplier ratings followed by an agreed rating
At least 70% hard measurable criteria and less than 30% subjective criteria
Both parties agree measures, weights, scores and corrective actions; bilateral sign-off
Previous three review scores and action meeting records
Evaluate actual performance against agreed requirements rather than negotiating commercial contract terms in the scorecard
source_reference.extensions: Three distinct profiles, ten expanded categories, proposed weights, measurable definitions, evidence requirements, strict critical-control rules, coverage and applicability rules, accountability dashboards and action workflow. These extensions are proposed, not existing CCBA policy.

accountability_types.SUPPLIER: Supplier is accountable for the measured outcome. Both parties may rate it.
accountability_types.ORGANIZATION: Buying organization is accountable for the measured outcome. Both parties may rate it.
accountability_types.BOTH: Jointly accountable outcome; score once using common evidence; assign actions separately as needed.

configuration.profile_selection: Select one profile for each separately managed scope. For mixed engagements create linked evaluations, or approve a composite with explicit scope weights totaling 100; do not simply sum the three scores.
configurable_fields: measurement counting basis and evidence sources
configuration.approval_rule: Agree and version configuration before the evaluation period begins. Any change to weights, scope or thresholds requires both parties to approve; keep historical versions unchanged.
configuration.threshold_rules: Default PASS/SLA thresholds are proposed starting points. Set per-question thresholds and SLA commitments to actual contractual/operational expectations; rating 4 should correspond to agreed target and rating 5 to a stretch target when feasible. For mandatory controls retain the binary compliance rubric. Thresholds must be monotonic, exhaustive and non-overlapping after precedence; higher/lower rates are evaluated without rounding.

CRITICAL.name: Mandatory control compliance
CRITICAL.note: Binary mandatory control: full compliance earns all allocated points (rating 5 for scoring purposes only, not a claim of exceeding legal obligations); any verified breach earns zero points and triggers independent escalation. Target rating 5. No partial credit.

rules.description: Consistently exceeds agreed expectations; proactive improvements and verifiable positive outcomes.
Meets agreed expectations consistently; reliable evidence and timely actions.
Partially meets expectations; recurring minor gaps or occasional intervention needed.
Frequently misses expectations; significant gaps or repeated intervention required.
Fails expectations; major unresolved gaps or demonstrated breakdown of the process.

scoring_policy.target_score_formula: Sum of effective question weights multiplied by the multiplier for each question target rating; may exceed 75 when critical controls apply.
scoring_policy.weight_basis: Question weights are percentage points of the entire profile, not percentages within categories. A category with weight 20 must contain questions totaling 20 points.
scoring_policy.rating_calculation: Use first matching rubric rule on measured value; quantitative agreed ratings must match verified evidence and approved thresholds. Do not average supplier and organization ratings automatically. Qualitative ratings require documented evidence and bilateral agreement.
data_rules: Use the same review period, counting unit, baseline and attribution rules for both parties.
Record numerator and denominator for percentage and rate metrics. Do not treat missing evidence or denominator zero as full compliance.
For HIGHER_IS_BETTER percent measures require values 0 through 100; for event rates require nonnegative values (may exceed 100).
Separate supplier-controlled and organization-controlled delays using documented exceptions; do not silently remove failures or change baseline dates retrospectively.
For an event-triggered metric with no relevant events, record NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale only after confirming no activity was due; missing data is NOT_EVALUATED.
A verified mandatory-control breach must be evaluated and escalated even when other observations are unavailable.

na_policy.formula: For approved N/A questions redistribute their weight proportionally among applicable questions in the same category: effective weight = original question weight * original category weight / sum(original weights of applicable questions in that category).
na_policy.whole_category_na: If all questions in a category are legitimately N/A, no final score until both parties approve a revised active category weighting totaling 100 and redistribution within those categories. Preserve the original baseline and audit trail.
na_policy.missing_or_disputed: NOT_EVALUATED, missing or disputed applicable questions retain weight. Show a provisional weighted-points earned and evidence coverage, not a final normalized score. Finalization requires all applicable items resolved.
na_policy.coverage_formula: 100 * sum(original weights of applicable questions with verified agreed ratings) / sum(original weights of applicable questions). Also report applicable original weight out of 100 and excluded weight separately. Minimum coverage applies to publishing a provisional score; final coverage must be 100%.
na_policy.measurability_check: After approved N/A redistribution or reweighting, check active quantitative weight remains at least 70% and active qualitative weight below 30%; otherwise approve a revised configuration before finalization.

critical_gate.trigger: Any verified critical-control failure or credible unresolved serious compliance allegation.
critical_gate.outcome: CRITICAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED; immediate appropriate containment, notification and management/compliance escalation. Do not issue an unconditional satisfactory status or renew/qualify a supplier solely on the numeric score. Attribute the finding to responsible party or parties.
critical_gate.closure: Record responsible owner, due date, verified corrective action and authorized risk/compliance disposition. Preserve original score and critical finding history.

accountability_subscores.formula: For each of SUPPLIER, ORGANIZATION and BOTH, sum agreed weighted points for questions in that group / sum effective weights of those questions * 100. Report null for zero applicable group weight.
accountability_subscores.note: Shared questions contribute once to overall score; separate group scores are diagnostic, not additive. A low organization score is not automatically a supplier failure.

scoring_policy.rounding: Keep full precision in computation; display scores to two decimals.
scoring_policy.band_note: Bands are proposed general indicators, separate from the engagement-specific weighted target and critical gate.

rules: Collect independent organization and supplier assessments before reconciliation.
Resolve differences against objective evidence; unresolved disputes remain visible and block finalization.
Record agreed corrective and improvement actions with named owners and deadlines.
Obtain both parties sign-off; keep disagreements or refusals in the audit log.
Track actions to verified completion and compare subsequent review scores.
